# Radoslav Radev Says Planche Lean Presses Can Be Done On The Floor Without Parallettes

Radoslav Radev says you don't need parallettes for planche lean presses: if you want, you can do them on the floor. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 01:16]

## Details

- He says you don't need parallettes; if you want, you can do the exercise just on the wrists on the floor. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 01:16]
- On the floor he says not to put the fingers forward but to rotate the hands with the thumb forward, or backward, which he says also works and is even harder. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 01:22]

## Evidence

- vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 01:16 (Radoslav Radev): "And you have to make the parallettes or you don't need parallettes. If you want, you can do it just on wrist, on the floor."
- vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 01:22 (Radoslav Radev): "But don't do it with fingers forward. you have to rotate them like this with the thumb forward or a backward like this also works and by the way it's even harder"
